label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
To: @marco
Replying to: i02
Cc: none
Subject: none

Marco, read this all the way through.

You did Desert Palms Saturday, 14 units, and not one code is in the sheet. The last thing you logged was Ortiz Tire on the 12th. Yvette called Lupe this morning because the tenant in 9B lost her key and wants 3 copies today, and I've got nothing to cut from. That's a customer waiting on us because the codes never got written down.

This is the second time. Kessler in September was the same thing, and I told you that day to get the codes in. Back on August 4 I put it out to everybody: every rekey, the codes go in the sheet the same day, before you leave the van. I said no exceptions. That wasn't a suggestion.

I'm not happy about this and I'm not going to act like I am. You're good with your hands, and I mean that. But this can't keep happening.

Here's what I need today. Go back out to Desert Palms now and decode 9B first so Yvette can get her keys. Then do as many of the other 13 as you can, all 14 if you get there. Put each one in the sheet with address, unit and code as you finish it, not at the end of the day. Text me when 9B is done.

Also, Yvette says there's a black pinning tray with pins in it on the counter in the leasing office. That's mine. Bring it back with you.

From here on the codes go in before you leave the job. Every job, no exceptions.
